name: Replay Gallery
description: Records clean runs locally, with optional online sharing, voting, and Safe Mode playback.

online-features.name: Online Features
online-features.description: Allow Replay Gallery to connect to Firebase to download and upload replay input data, submit anonymous Keep/Remove votes using a random installation ID, and send feedback containing your Geometry Dash username and current level ID/version. Turn this off to keep recordings local and stop network requests.
